task_summary: Build a Python function that parses CIF files, extracts Wyckoff position multiplicities and representative fractional coordinates (as rationalized fractions), and returns them in a specified dictionary format.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three clear concerns: (1) CIF file parsing and structure loading, (2) symmetry analysis to extract Wyckoff positions with multiplicities and coordinates, and (3) floating-point to rational fraction conversion. However, these are tightly coupled in a single pipeline with a single entry function, so two skills suffice: one for CIF parsing + symmetry/Wyckoff extraction (the core crystallography pipeline), and one for coordinate rationalization (the numerical formatting concern).

skills.name: evo-crystallography-wyckoff-analysis
skills.description: Parses CIF files using pymatgen, performs space group symmetry analysis via SpacegroupAnalyzer, and extracts Wyckoff position letters, multiplicities, and representative atom fractional coordinates from the symmetrized structure.
skills.responsibility: CIF file loading (via CifParser/parse_structures), structure symmetry analysis (SpacegroupAnalyzer with appropriate symprec), extraction of wyckoff_symbols, equivalent_sites, multiplicities, and the first atom's fractional coordinates for each unique Wyckoff position.

skills.name: evo-crystallography-fraction-format
skills.description: Converts floating-point fractional coordinates to clean rational fraction strings with bounded denominators (≤12), handling edge cases like near-zero/near-one wrapping and integer values.
skills.responsibility: Floating-point to rational number conversion using sympy.Rational.limit_denominator, coordinate wrapping to [0,1), boundary snapping for near-0 and near-1 values, and string formatting of fractions.
dr_sections: 5. Converting Float Coordinates to Simple Fractions Using SymPy
